issues.title: Incorrect revenue calculation
issues.problem: Revenue should only include transactions with status 'COMPLETED', but the query includes all transactions where status is not 'FAILED'.
issues.fix: SUM(CASE WHEN t.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN t.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_REVENUE

issues.title: Missing filter for 'COMPLETED' status
issues.problem: The query should filter for transactions with status 'COMPLETED' to correctly calculate revenue.

issues.title: Inconsistent naming convention
issues.problem: The query uses inconsistent naming conventions (uppercase vs. camelCase). It should be consistent for readability.
issues.fix: SELECT m.merchant_name, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS total_txns

review.corrected_sql: SELECT m.merchant_name, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS total_txns FROM sigma_analytics.fact_transactions t JOIN sigma_analytics.dim_merchant m ON t.merchant_id = m.merchant_id WHERE t.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY m.merchant_name;
review.summary: The query had critical correctness issues with revenue calculation and missing filters. It also had readability issues with inconsistent naming conventions.
